task: Add all top-level JohnS/VGMRIPS Arcade UAC packages to the hosted SPCBOY catalog

sourceSet.duration: VGM header totalSamples divided by 44,100 Hz; stored as playMilliseconds for playback and durationSeconds for display
sourceSet.packagePlaylistPolicy: Choose the longest nonempty unique-member VGM playlist per UAC; packages without a nonempty playlist publish all playable VGM members. Largest tied playlists have identical member sets.
sourceSet.scope: Top-level UAC files only; nested manufacturer folders are separate imports.

artwork.selection: first in-archive PNG per UAC, matching the SPCBOY gallery builder
